children: In August 2026, the Company achieved average time charter equivalent earnings of approximately US$95,073 per day, net, for the Company’s vessel trading on fixed rate time charter.
The Board has approved a cash distribution of US$0.025 per share for August 2026. The distribution will be made from the Company’s Contributed Surplus account.
Payment date: On or about September 18, 2026

title: Bruton Limited (BRUT) – Commercial update and key information relating to the cash distribution for August 2026
